author: brossow
releaseNotes: Water heater: new Product Health attributes from the Rheem app -- leak sensor, shut-off valve, tank health and compressor health, each with the app's own status text -- on units that report them. Energy and water use from the app's Usage Report: today so far and the last 24 hours, which matches the app's 24 Hrs. view. Today's energy is also the standard EnergyMeter attribute, for energy apps and integrations. Usage is read at five past every hour. Both drivers: a brief EcoNet or DNS outage no longer logs an error on every poll. A run of failed polls logs one warning, one line when polls work again, and an error only if it lasts half an hour. Confirmed on a Gen 5 heat pump water heater; gas, tankless and electric-only water heaters are still untested, and reports are welcome.
